note.title: Coaming doesn't manage this stack
note.body: You can look at it here. Adopt it to deploy, update and roll it back with Coaming. Adopting changes nothing until you deploy.

orphan.title: Created by Coaming (another instance or a lost record)
orphan.body: This stack carries a Coaming ID that this instance doesn't know. Adopting it works like any other stack, and the first deploy replaces the old ID labels.

portainer.title: This stack looks like it was created by Portainer
portainer.body: Remove it from Portainer without deleting it, or the two tools will fight over it. Coaming doesn't contact Portainer.

services.empty: No service of this stack is running.

resources.caption: Labelled objects would be owned by the stack after adopting. The others stay external.

gone.heading: This stack is gone
gone.body: It was removed outside Coaming, or it is now managed. Go back to the list to find it.

error.body: Check the connection and try again.
